_comment: Aquaryn host-owned encounter tuning. Starting numbers; runtime fight and shoreline basin integration remain required before acceptance.
_comment_rewards: Defeat and validated host catch both settle the world encounter and durable eligible-character entitlements. No inventory capacity requirement for the Swim Stone unlock.

authority._comment: Host validates deployed creature and observed character/realm/position. Client payload contains encounter identity and intent, never HP, phase, participants or reward eligibility.

phases.name: Shore Crest
phases._comment: Opening shore stance: broad tail sweep, clear flank recovery. No HP multiplier.

phases.name: Tidal Run
phases._comment: Below70percent: visible surface-channel run then another exposed shore. Submergence is animation only; targets remain reachable without diving.

phases.name: Broken Wake
phases._comment: Below35percent: narrow frontal jet leaves both flanks exposed, alternating with the visible channel return.

placement._comment: Existing Tidal Basin landmark X/Z; ground samples the shipped bake. Channel coordinates will be enabled with the authored basin terrain, never simulated by teleportation.

movement._comment: Host movement uses grounded shore waypoints and a visible sea-level channel. Never teleport a target between stances.
